ex.en: Tom is a flight attendant.
ex.zh: 湯姆是空服員。

ex.en: The parking attendant showed us where to park.
ex.zh: 停車場管理員告訴我們要停在哪裡。

ex.en: Please ask a flight attendant if you need a blanket.
ex.zh: 如果需要毯子，請向空服員索取。

ex.en: Does Tom have an attorney?
ex.zh: 湯姆有請律師嗎？

ex.en: You should talk to an attorney before signing the contract.
ex.zh: 簽約前你應該先諮詢律師。

ex.en: Our attorney will review the agreement.
ex.zh: 我們的律師會審閱這份協議。

ex.en: That aim is impossible to attain.
ex.zh: 那個目標不可能達成。

ex.en: At last he attained his goal.
ex.zh: 他終於達到目標了。

ex.en: They attained their purpose at last.
ex.zh: 他們終於達到了目的。

ex.en: The boy put on his athletic shoes and ran outside.
ex.zh: 那個男孩穿上運動鞋，跑到外面去。

ex.en: Owing to the rain, the athletic meeting was put off.
ex.zh: 運動會因為下雨延期了。

ex.en: I think Tom is athletic.
ex.zh: 我覺得湯姆很有運動細胞。

ex.en: He has a tall, athletic build.
ex.zh: 他身材高大健壯。

ex.en: Business attire is required for the meeting.
ex.zh: 這場會議須穿著商務服裝。

ex.en: Please wear casual attire for the company picnic.
ex.zh: 公司野餐請穿休閒服裝。

ex.en: The drop in sales is attributable to bad weather.
ex.zh: 銷售下滑可歸因於天氣不佳。

ex.en: Half of the cost increase is attributable to fuel prices.
ex.zh: 成本增加有一半是油價造成的。

ex.en: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
ex.zh: 一個水分子由兩個氫原子和一個氧原子組成。

ex.en: Everything around us is made of atoms.
ex.zh: 我們周遭的一切都是由原子構成的。

ex.en: You should pay more attention to what he says.
ex.zh: 你應該多注意他說的話。

ex.en: Give your whole attention to what you are doing.
ex.zh: 請專心做你正在做的事。

ex.en: The first subject that attracted my attention was philosophy.
ex.zh: 第一個吸引我注意的科目是哲學。

ex.en: The enemy made a strong attack on that building.
ex.zh: 敵人對那棟建築發動了猛烈攻擊。

ex.en: The attack happened late at night.
ex.zh: 攻擊事件發生在深夜。

ex.en: The Japanese attacked Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941.
ex.zh: 日本在一九四一年十二月七日襲擊珍珠港。

ex.en: The newspaper attacked the government's new policy.
ex.zh: 報紙抨擊政府的新政策。

ex.en: Sleep deprivation increases risk of heart attacks.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足會增加心臟病發作的風險。

ex.en: She had an asthma attack at work.
ex.zh: 她在上班時氣喘發作。

ex.en: All of my attempts have failed.
ex.zh: 我所有的嘗試都失敗了。

ex.en: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
ex.zh: 他試圖游過那條河，但失敗了。

ex.en: The old man attempted to swim five kilometers.
ex.zh: 那位老人試圖游五公里。

ex.en: This film attempts to break stereotypes and redefine what true masculinity is.
ex.zh: 這部電影試圖打破刻板印象，重新定義真正的男子氣概。

ex.en: Try to have a positive attitude about everything.
ex.zh: 試著對每件事都抱持積極的態度。

ex.en: I hope to improve my attitude to work.
ex.zh: 我希望改善自己的工作態度。

ex.en: I am alarmed by your irresponsible attitude.
ex.zh: 你不負責任的態度讓我很擔心。

ex.en: Black Friday sales attract shoppers.
ex.zh: 黑色星期五促銷吸引了大批購物人潮。

ex.en: Hsinchu's meatballs and rice noodles are very famous, attracting many tourists to taste them.
ex.zh: 新竹的貢丸和米粉非常有名，吸引許多遊客前來品嚐。

ex.en: The first subject that attracted my attention was philosophy.
ex.zh: 第一個吸引我注意的科目是哲學。

ex.en: I've been attracted to rabbits ever since.
ex.zh: 從那之後，我就被兔子迷住了。

ex.en: I was attracted to her sense of humor.
ex.zh: 我被她的幽默感吸引。

ex.en: This place has a mysterious atmosphere to it.
ex.zh: 這個地方有種神秘的氣氛。

ex.en: The atmosphere is always extremely lively when eating hot pot.
ex.zh: 吃火鍋的時候，氣氛總是非常熱鬧。

ex.en: There was a different kind of atmosphere in the headquarters.
ex.zh: 總部裡的氣氛有點不一樣。

ex.en: The asteroid broke up into small pieces as it entered Earth's atmosphere.
ex.zh: 小行星進入地球大氣層後碎裂成許多小塊。

ex.en: Saving energy can reduce the emission of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere.
ex.zh: 節約能源可以減少排放到大氣中的溫室氣體。

ex.en: She has attractive eyes.
ex.zh: 她有一雙迷人的眼睛。

ex.en: Jane is more attractive than Susan.
ex.zh: 珍比蘇珊更有魅力。

ex.en: The company offers an attractive salary.
ex.zh: 這家公司提供很誘人的薪資。

ex.en: The price is very attractive.
ex.zh: 這個價格很吸引人。

attribute.zh: 把…歸因於、歸功於（attribute A to B）

ex.en: He attributed his success to good luck.
ex.zh: 他把自己的成功歸功於好運。

ex.en: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.
ex.zh: 把你的失敗歸咎於父母是不公平的。

ex.en: Patience is an important attribute for a teacher.
ex.zh: 耐心是老師很重要的特質。

ex.en: What attributes do you look for in a new employee?
ex.zh: 你看重新員工的哪些特質？

ex.en: That athlete won three times in a row in this tournament.
ex.zh: 那位選手在這次錦標賽中三連勝。

ex.en: Tom is a natural athlete.
ex.zh: 湯姆是天生的運動員。

ex.en: Professional athletes train almost every day.
ex.zh: 職業運動員幾乎每天都在訓練。

ex.en: John Dalton was the creator of the atomic theory.
ex.zh: 約翰．道耳頓是原子學說的創始人。

ex.en: We are in the era of atomic energy.
ex.zh: 我們身處原子能時代。

ex.en: The atomic reactor generates enormous amounts of thermal energy.
ex.zh: 原子反應爐會產生大量熱能。

ex.en: Bonuses are linked to the attainment of sales targets.
ex.zh: 獎金和是否達成業績目標連動。

ex.en: The report measures the attainment of each project goal.
ex.zh: 這份報告評估每個專案目標的達成情況。

ex.en: Look up the country in the atlas to see where it is.
ex.zh: 在地圖集裡查一下那個國家，看看它在哪裡。

ex.en: Our school library has a large world atlas.
ex.zh: 我們學校圖書館有一本大型的世界地圖集。

ex.en: A card was attached to the gift.
ex.zh: 一張卡片被附在了禮物上。

ex.en: Attached is my monthly report.
ex.zh: 附上我這個月的報告。

ex.en: I attached my signature to the document.
ex.zh: 我簽署了檔案。

ex.en: Mary is very attached to the little girl.
ex.zh: 瑪莉很喜歡那個小女孩。

ex.en: The boy is deeply attached to his grandmother.
ex.zh: 那個男孩對奶奶非常依戀。

ex.en: All attendees will receive a free T-shirt.
ex.zh: 所有出席者都會拿到一件免費 T 恤。

ex.en: The conference had over 2,000 attendees.
ex.zh: 這場研討會有超過兩千名與會者。

ex.en: Attendance is compulsory for all members.
ex.zh: 所有成員都必須出席。

ex.en: Firstly, let's check the attendance.
ex.zh: 首先，我們來點名。

ex.en: Attendance at the meeting was low.
ex.zh: 這次會議出席的人很少。

attrition.zh: 人員自然流失（退休、離職不補人）

ex.en: The company will reduce staff through attrition, not layoffs.
ex.zh: 公司會透過自然流失減少人力，而不是裁員。

ex.en: Attrition in the sales team is very high.
ex.zh: 業務團隊的人員流失率很高。

ex.en: The war became a war of attrition.
ex.zh: 這場戰爭變成了消耗戰。

ex.en: Constant stress leads to the attrition of motivation.
ex.zh: 持續的壓力會消磨人的動力。

ex.en: The owners converted the attic into a quiet home office.
ex.zh: 屋主把閣樓改造成安靜的居家辦公室。

ex.en: Boxes from the previous tenant remained in the attic.
ex.zh: 前一位房客留下的箱子還放在閣樓裡。

ex.en: The coral reef is the region's prime attraction.
ex.zh: 珊瑚礁是這個地區的主要景點。

ex.en: The tickets for this attraction can only be bought online.
ex.zh: 這個景點的門票只能在網路上購買。

ex.en: Edinburgh already offers a busy and traditional city experience, with many historic buildings and tourist attractions.
ex.zh: 愛丁堡本來就是個熱鬧又傳統的城市，有許多歷史建築和觀光景點。

ex.en: I can't understand the attraction of horror movies.
ex.zh: 我無法理解恐怖片的吸引力在哪裡。

ex.en: There was an instant attraction between them.
ex.zh: 他們一見面就互相吸引。

ex.en: She tried to persuade him to attend the meeting.
ex.zh: 她試圖說服他來參加會議。

ex.en: He attended the meeting as the company representative.
ex.zh: 他代表我們公司出席了會議。

ex.en: She couldn't attend that party because she was sick.
ex.zh: 她因為生病沒辦法參加那場派對。

ex.en: Attending high school in Korea is tough.
ex.zh: 在韓國上高中很辛苦。

ex.en: Tom attends state school.
ex.zh: 湯姆念公立學校。

ex.en: Please see the attachment for more details.
ex.zh: 詳細內容請見附件。

ex.en: The attachment is too large to send.
ex.zh: 附件太大，寄不出去。

ex.en: Children often form a strong attachment to their toys.
ex.zh: 孩子常常對玩具產生很深的依戀。

ex.en: She has a deep attachment to her hometown.
ex.zh: 她對家鄉有很深的感情。

ex.en: You need to attach your photo to the application form.
ex.zh: 你必須在申請表上貼上照片。

ex.en: Please attach a certificate of quality.
ex.zh: 請附上品質證明書。

ex.en: I've attached the report to this email.
ex.zh: 我已經把報告附在這封電子郵件裡。

ex.en: I forgot to attach a stamp to the envelope.
ex.zh: 我忘記在信封上貼郵票了。

ex.en: The device is attached fast to the ceiling.
ex.zh: 這個裝置被牢牢固定在天花板上。

ex.en: Mary is very attached to the little girl.
ex.zh: 瑪莉很喜歡那個小女孩。

ex.en: He's very attached to his old car.
ex.zh: 他對他的舊車很有感情。

ex.en: Why don't you drop in for tea at your convenience?
ex.zh: 你方便的時候過來喝杯茶吧。

ex.en: Please call me back at your convenience.
ex.zh: 您方便時請回電給我。

ex.en: Please send us the signed contract at your earliest convenience.
ex.zh: 請盡早將簽好的合約寄給我們。

ex.en: I would appreciate a reply at your earliest convenience.
ex.zh: 若能盡早回覆，將不勝感激。
